title: Move the screen away
hook: Change screen distance and predict fringe spacing.
misconception: fringe spacing stays fixed when screen distance doubles.
objective: Apply Δy ≈ λL/d to compare fringe spacing when screen distance changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With two narrow slits in the small-angle limit with fixed wavelength and slit separation, Δy ≈ λL/d. When screen distance doubles, fringe spacing becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model Δy ≈ λL/d; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider two narrow slits in the small-angle limit with fixed wavelength and slit separation, with a nonzero initial result. If screen distance triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on fringe spacing?
recall.why: Apply Δy ≈ λL/d under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
